Location: Gurugram(Work From Office)Position: Senior Product DesignerExperience Level: 5+ Years of crafting great user experience and driving innovationIndustry: Beauty B2C
Know about the company India’s largest beauty and wellness destination with more than half a million happy customers. Design at Nykaa welcomes candidates with diverse backgrounds, expertise, and perspectives. It offers opportunities for constant learning with fun and interactive sessions. It is a place where you’d feel welcomed and can contribute your skills and expertise to help build the business growth. We are committed to the safety and well-being of our employees, vendors, and clients.
Life at Nykaa Design: Where Style, Meets Strategy ✨Imagine vibrant hues of creativity, collaborative spirits that thrive on trust, and an unending bank of ideas that’s every day at Nykaa Design. We are a tight bunch of progressive youth making beauty and fashion accessible to all through user-first experiences. We don’t just accept your unique style; we celebrate it! Whether it’s fun interactive sessions or working as a collective to build exceptional shopping journeys, Nykaa Design is a place where every member is an equal and every voice matters.
The Role: Creative, Visionary & Pragmatic Problem-SolverAs a Staff/Lead Product Designer, you aren’t just designing screens; you are setting the long-term vision for our digital products. As you stand as a custodian for our consumers, keeping your views in front of leaders within the org. You’ll also be the guardian to the team enriching, defending, challenging and ensuring delivery. While we revolutionize how the world learns and shops beauty.
What You’ll Do: Lead, Innovate, & ElevateInnovate & Elevate: Stay on top of design trends and emerging technologies, bringing fresh ideas that push the boundaries of user experience on B2C platforms.Product Design Execution/Ownership: Own product experiences in certain pod structures, from early concepts and user flows to final execution and launch.Define design direction for key product areas and ensure a clear, consistent experience across multiple touchpoints while advocating for users and balancing customer needs with business goals and technical constraints.Solving complex user and business problems by turning insights, data, and customer needs into simple, effective experiences.Functional Ownership:Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other teams. Influence product decisions beyond visual design and help teams make clear, user-focused decisions.Identify opportunities to improve the overall customer experience across the product ecosystem.Lead and mentor designers, helping them grow their craft, product thinking, and ownership by setting clear design standards and ways of working across the team.Provide thoughtful feedback, challenge ideas constructively, and help designers make stronger decisions.Foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where designers can experiment, take ownership, and do their best work. Raise the overall quality and maturity of the design practice through better processes, principles, and collaboration.
Who You AreYou have 5+ years of experience designing compelling user experiences for B2C platforms.You are a systems thinker who sees the larger ecosystem, not just isolated features.You possess the psychological power to place yourself in the user's shoes and a highly refined aesthetic sense.You are opinionated, able to give constructive feedback, and passionate about establishing a perspective behind design decisions.
Why You’ll Love It Here
Unparalleled Ownership: Freedom to take initiative and make mistakes so we can learn together.Learning Playground: Constant learning, regular sync-ups, and a transparent, feedback-positive environment.
Celebration & Support: Timely celebrations to acknowledge success and leaders who are approachable and eager to support you.
How Our Team LooksWe’re a close-knit team of designers, researchers, writers, visual designers. These are super creative minds from different backgrounds and cultures. Different perspectives, one shared love for making things better for our users. We brainstorm, debate, experiment, obsess over details, and occasionally ask, “But what if we tried this?” Our intrapreneurial culture gives us the space to explore ideas, solve tricky problems, and build experiences people love.
Different disciplines. One team. Lots of ideas.
🎨Product Designers We turn “this could be better” into “this feels effortless.” Our Product Designers work across Nykaa’s products, making complex things feel simple, intuitive, and delightful. They think about the big picture, sweat the small stuff, and keep iterating until the experience feels just right.🔍UX Research We’re curious. Very curious. Our UX Researchers dig into what customers do, need, think, and sometimes don’t say. Their insights help us uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make better product decisions.✍️UX Writing Yes, we really do debate one word. Our UX Writers make sure Nykaa’s products don’t just look good, they sound good too. From tiny bits of microcopy to larger content experiences, they turn complex moments into clear, helpful, and human ones.⚙️Design OperationsSomeone has to keep all the creative chaos moving. Design Operations makes it easier for everyone to do their best work. They think about tools, workflows, collaboration, learning, and culture basically, all the things that help a design team run smoothly.✨Product Visual DesignProduct Visual Design, Illustration & Motion The team that makes us stop and say, “Ooh, nice.” They bring personality to Nykaa through colour, type, illustration, animation, and all the little details in between. They collaborate with Product Designers to turn ideas into experiences that are polished, expressive, and unmistakably Nykaa.
